meta.name: Kong — sage grid and electric lime
meta.scope: Public marketing site. 17 sitemaps, 3200 addresses, 2677 HTTP-200 responses; 25 rendered pages plus desktop/mobile, light/dark, Agent and hover states. Not every page visually inspected; late requests blocked by 403.
meta.evidence: Values measured from CSS/runtime unless labelled inferred or source-only. Style descriptions are interpretation. Unobserved effects are disabled; unknown tokens/states must come from the destination system.

color.palette_type: Analogous greens: sage surfaces, forest-black ink, electric lime accent.

primary.role: Area-dominant light background (--theme-bg-0), distinct from CSS --theme-primary.

accent.role: Brand, pills, selected tabs, announcements, closing CTA bands, dark links.

neutral.usage: Light body #4a4d49; headings #001408/black; grid #aeb5a7; crosses #4b4e46. Theme roles remap rather than invert.

surface.elevated: Inputs #e7ede5 light / #101110 dark; header #bcc2ba light / black dark.

color.contrast_strategy: Strong text/CTA contrast; subtle surface layers punctuated by lime bands.
color.semantic_token_caveat: --theme-primary: light #001408, dark #ccff00. Hero/header can explicitly use lime in both; light form submits use forest-black.

typography.font_style_notes: Broad sans; heavy 700/800 headings, 300 italic cycling subhead at 32–52px. Exact font aliases; full name not decoded. Space Grotesk/League Gothic also declared, not global defaults.
typography.template_variants: Desktop titles: product/pricing 90px; blog/press/video 60px; customer story 48px; gated resource/event 32px. Heading level does not determine size.

spacing.content_density: Spacious introductions; denser editorial, comparison and form grids.
spacing.section_rhythm: Section padding 60–80px; 1px bands and adjoining cells, often no card gaps.

layout.grid_system: Named CSS Grid tracks: full / left rail / content / right rail / slack; visible rails and crosshairs.
layout.max_content_width: 1340px cap; 1440px viewport yields 1320px between two 60px rails, about 1240px after inner padding.
layout.columns: 12-column spans; 6/6, 8/4, thirds; article sidebar 340px. Mobile stacks.

breakpoints.notes: Other component thresholds: 375/500/600/900/1000/1100. Hands hidden below 1000; mobile nav below 1150.

layout.alignment_tendency: Strict scaffold; centered marketing, left-aligned editorial/forms.

shape.border_usage: 1px shared grid edges; control borders vary by state.
shape.divider_style: Continuous rules, small registration crosses; local dotted panels.

elevation.shadow_style: Mostly flat; local overlays/special components only.

levels.low: none on observed standard cards and pills
levels.medium: Source-only ProductCard: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2), hover alpha .4. Not a global elevation token.
levels.high: Source-only GradientCard: 0 0 16px rgba(0,0,0,.3), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.5); cookie overlay visibly has a diffuse shadow.

elevation.depth_cues: Fill, hairlines, raster overlaps, frosted nav.

iconography.style: Outline UI glyphs, technical symbols, crosses/arrows; solid lime gorilla logo.

motion.easing: Buttons cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1); mode transition cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); hand imagery cubic-bezier(.29,.01,.19,.99); continuous loops linear.

duration_scale.macro: 2s hand transform; portrait shader 2.5s in / .6s out; footer ring 30s linear loop

motion.entrance_pattern: Local CSS/DOM transitions, viewport-gated media, hover shader; no global fade-up recipe verified.
motion.exit_pattern: Reverse transitions; shader returns then disposes context.
motion.philosophy: Stable reading layout, expressive accents. Reduced-motion CSS exists; JS/video coverage unverified.

components.button_style: Bold pills: lime/forest inverse primary, sage secondary, optional arrow. Desktop height/text/horizontal-padding: 46/16/16px, 69/24/24px; footer height/text 92/32px. Form submits full width. Hover fill + arrow/padding.
components.input_style: 54px height, 16/24px text, 14px 18px padding; pill, #e7ede5 light / #101110 dark. Short fields in two columns, selects full width, textarea rounded rectangle. Home email + CTA share capsule. In-field labels; submit states untested.
components.card_style: Connected square hairline cells: image/category/title/link. Hover/focus-within inset outline + diagonal highlight; no lift. Pill tabs inside square framing.
components.navigation_pattern: Lime banner → sticky centered-logo nav → category subnav → breadcrumbs. Left rail Human/Agent; theme controls rail/footer. Mobile full-height stacked menu + full-width CTAs.
components.modal_style: Source-only: fixed centered overlay, black/.6 backdrop, viewport-constrained content, close button. Observed cookie panel: rounded lower-left desktop, bottom-width mobile.
components.list_style: Hairline resource/legal cells; featured article + supporting stories; article metadata/TOC/sidebar; pricing rows + category pills.
components.component_notes: Shared scaffold, local hierarchy. Lead capture: minimal nav, form-left/proof-right. Resources: narrative-left/form-right. External signup is a separate system.

fluid_tokens.rule: Each [min,max] is px, linearly interpolated over viewport 375–1440px: clamp(min*1px, calc(min*1px + (max-min)*(100vw - 375px)/1065), max*1px).

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Precision grid meets biological/robotic frontier: gorilla/machine hands, crosshairs, terminal, neon.
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary AI infrastructure with drafting/retro-terminal cues.
aesthetic.genre: Enterprise developer marketing; editorial scale, technical ornament.

visual_language.ornamentation: Grids, dots, crosses, rail comets, raster scenes.
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Broad statements in spacious bands; denser evidence below.
visual_language.focal_strategy: Dominant hero, alternating evidence, broad closing CTA.
visual_language.texture_usage: Local dots/halftone, rendered materials; no universal grain/noise.

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale, weight, bands, shared edges, selective lime.
composition.flow_direction: Vertical, with comparisons and alternating splits.
composition.grouping_strategy: Contiguous border cells and shared fill.
composition.negative_space_role: Isolate claims, reveal grid, frame heavy type.

imagery.photo_treatment: Grayscale logos; natural portraits on lime; branded customer compositions and UI captures. Archival thumbnails retain colors.
imagery.illustration_style: Pre-rendered gorilla/robot cutouts, sculptures, diagrams; company hero looping video.
imagery.graphic_elements: Crosses, dots, arrows, connectors, gorilla emblem, terminal symbols.
imagery.pattern_usage: Local dot/cross fields; stronger summit symbol pattern.
imagery.image_shape: Full-bleed rectangles, square portraits, 16:9 videos, transparent overlapping cutouts.

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Portrait halftone; other cards outline/highlight; translated imagery.
interaction_feel.transition_personality: Quick controls, slow smooth decoration; no spring signature.
interaction_feel.loading_style: Lazy media/Lottie; no general skeleton verified. Broken demo images excluded.

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Short imperatives: demo/trial/access; event countdown urgency.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Branded 404: centered plain heading + site shell. Infrastructure 403 excluded.

overview.performance_tier: CSS/DOM baseline; local SVG/video and WebGL.
overview.fallback_strategy: Shader failure retains image; context released after exit. Reduced-motion CSS disables some loops/transitions; full JS/video behavior unverified.

background_effects.type: Grid/dot fields, rail comets; company video hero

particle_systems.note: No particle engine; rail comets are CSS.

3d_elements.note: Fur/metal/stone and cinematic glow baked into raster/video; shader is a flat quad.

shader_effects.description: Company ProfileCard hover verified: portrait filters/pixelates/fades into wandering black crosses on lime.
shader_effects.technology: WebGL 1 / GLSL, requestAnimationFrame, textured TRIANGLE_STRIP quad.

params.fragment_output: Grayscale → block sampling → alpha fade → crosses
params.noise_type: Custom time/phase wandering; noise family unverified.
params.distortion: Cell size 10→25, min 0, max 1→.4; 30fps target; in easeOutQuad 2.5s, out easeInQuad .6s. Continuous cell wandering while hovered.

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: Source Lottie component: prefetch rootMargin 200px 0px 400px 0px; visibility -60px 0px 0% 0px; intro middle -30% 0px -30% 0px.
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: Source-only Lottie SVG visibility play/pause; optional intro + loop. CSS sticky nav/panel stacking.

params.animation_per_unit: Typing/deleting; cursor step-end blink; mode size/color/transform

text_effects.description: Cycling italic homepage subline; mode becomes document-like.

params.reveal_animation: Local hover; no global clip reveal verified

canvas_drawings.note: Same effect as shader_effects, not an additional generative canvas.

params.duration: Ring 30s linear infinite; pieces 1.5s hover rotation

svg_animations.note: No verified path morph, stroke-draw or universal filter stack.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Keep CSS comets, DOM typing, prerecorded hero media, SVG rotation and portrait WebGL distinct. Mode change is user-triggered, not scroll-driven.

agent_mode.appearance: Black/lime document with literal Markdown notation; decorative media hidden.
agent_mode.caveat: CSS declares mono, but runtime heading remained Funnel.

summit.appearance: Black/lime/bright-green, symbol/pixel pattern, branded hero graphic, countdown; event-only.

insomnia_css.evidence: Source-only palette; route HTML fetched, later browser 403. Whole-route purple styling unverified.

signup_redirect.appearance: Pale page, raised white form card, 4px outlined inputs, 20px heading, social login, lime-on-black submit.
signup_redirect.scope: External auth landing only; not marketing tokens.
